causal_chain: WH3 emitted FEASIBILITY_POLL_TICK immediately after executor readiness.
The sidecar re-read the append log through parse_probe_log.parse_logs.
The parser treated FEASIBILITY_POLL_TICK as an unknown event and raised ProbeLogError.
The sidecar recorded WAITING_RETRY_AFTER_PARSE_OR_PIPELINE_ERROR before request generation could complete.
offline_root_cause.defect: The generic probe parser did not allow FEASIBILITY_POLL_TICK or FEASIBILITY_REQUEST_SEEN, and its summarized session validator did not accept campaign_feasibility as a probe kind with snapshots.

owner_runtime_observation.interpretation: The v0.2I-r1 real/UI timer executed in the owner runtime, but the local sidecar failed while parsing the newly emitted diagnostic event before it could write a request for WH3 to consume.
